title: jmap: HTTP surface, Session, API dispatch
description: Per the approved .12 plan §3. jmap/{mod,session,api,bus}.rs plus empty register() stubs for every methods/*.rs file (chat_set, message_set, key_package, key_material, room_create, room_update, room_send, room_unbind, group_info), so later beads edit only their own file. The router merges into http::router on the same listener under /jmap/* and /.well-known/jmap (JM-11, .12.28). Session (RFC 8620): uploadUrl/downloadUrl point at a route that answers 404 (Limitation: no blobs); account capability urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi (userUri, roomIdPrefix, hubSender via a new public Hub accessor, cipherSuites [1], maxKeyPackages from config with a named default, labelled INVENTED VALUE); supportedBodyTypes text/plain and application/mimi-fanout. API dispatch on crate-jmap jmap_server, depended on by git rev pin (JM-5, .12.21; pinning needs a pushed crate-jmap rev, so ask before any crate-jmap write). Named limits: maxSizeRequest covering base64 growth of MAX_BODY_LEN, maxCallsInRequest, maxObjectsInSet. ChangeBus fed by Follower::subscribe. Tests: Session JSON checked against hand-written JSON from the draft; hostile requests (huge, deep, too many calls); unknown capability refused. Depends on .11.1.
